verdict.rationale: Docs imply a free/paid tier split (e.g., 'paid subscriptions' unlock analytics, docs-9) and community members describe using NotebookLM extensively for study/research without any stated cost, suggesting a usable free tier exists. However, no evidence pack item explicitly states free-tier limits, quotas, or trial terms for researchers. Missing for 10: explicit free-tier feature/quota list, comparison of free vs paid limits, and confirmation that core research workflows (upload, chat, audio overview) are unrestricted on free plan.
